title: BLIND-2 / BLIND-2R: Blind multi-author adversarial battery against the SQUIRL OS PQC gate (20 attacks, convergent front-run DoS finding, SIP-026 remediation, 20/20 post-fix verification)
description:
BLIND-2: a blind multi-author adversarial battery against the SQUIRL OS PORTCULLIS post-quantum crypto gate, plus BLIND-2R post-fix verification.

METHOD: Four independent context-blind model instances (same model family, disclosed; zero implementation knowledge) each authored five attacks from a public-claims digest only. The 20 attack slots were frozen verbatim (sha 46d24736) under a preregistration frozen before execution (content sha 1f0f20e6). Adjudication is deterministic against the frozen gate code (v1.1, sha 1fb167c6) and frozen governance semantics; no LLM sits in the decision path. Verdicts follow each blind author's own binary success conditions, with every interpretive choice disclosed.

RESULT: 16/20 attacks repelled; 4/20 attacker successes, all one mechanism: a burn-on-parse nonce front-run denial-of-service, independently authored by all four blind instances (confidences 0.95/0.95/0.90/0.95) - the strongest possible blind evidence that it is the salient gap. Availability axis only; no privilege escalation; no state corruption.

REMEDIATION: SIP-026 (sender-scoped nonce consumption; burn key = authenticated submitter + nonce) approved by the owner, implemented as forward-only gate amendment v1.2 (sha ef7076d8). BLIND-2R re-ran all 20 frozen slots against v1.2: 20/20 repelled, with a replay-regression control proving the prior SIP-024 replay-oracle closure is preserved (owner first use admitted; same-namespace replay refused).

REPRODUCE: verify the frozen-corpus shas, run blind2_battery.py (expect 16/20 repelled), apply gate v1.2, run blind2r_battery.py (expect 20/20 repelled + control PASS). Both crossing journals are included for line-by-line audit. Failure receipts are published, not hidden: a clean sheet would prove nothing.

Dual Mesh Benchmark (scoped): MEASURED (DeepSeek column, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23345241); NOT MEASURED otherwise.

This software is a prototype and is provided for educational and research purposes only. It is not intended for production use, commercial deployment, or safety-critical environments. All data is synthetic.
